scope: construction-only power gate for a fresh-query HM3D controller-portability population
scientific_question: Can unused actual-online histories support a role-balanced, result-blind population for NavDP/ViNT baseline-versus-CEC evaluation?

identity_exclusion.rule: exclude every scene/episode identity in the consumed 28-history manifest before query construction

query_contract.history: causal actual-online full-monocular Goal-A RGB history
query_contract.direction_rule: try the identity's preassigned front/side/rear stratum first, then the other two in an identity-hash-bound order; retain the first structurally valid unsupported Novel query

population_selection.rule: use the smallest prefix meeting all three structural targets; otherwise seal all 54 scenes as an underpowered construction result

authorization.future_vint_bearing_execution: physical zero-translation turns of at most 30 degrees with one fresh observation and one shadow update per turn

claim_boundary.allowed: fresh-query, scene-overlap controller portability after a passing formal evaluation
forbidden: reuse of the consumed 28 query identities
navigation SR inferred from construction counts
outcome-aware rerun of the five inspected ViNT losses
